subtitulo: Paste your prompt and tell us what you want to achieve: we'll tell you what's missing and why.
ayuda_resultado: Describe in your own words what you want to get. Required.
aviso_envio: Your prompt will be sent to {proveedor} (model {modelo}). Don't include personal or confidential data.
sin_problemas: We found no important problems: your prompt is well set up for what you want.
rechazado: We can't help with this request because it asks for something illegal or dangerous.
tu_prompt: Your prompt, with the problem fragments highlighted
cat_3: Doesn't say who it's for or the tone
cat_4: Doesn't say what form the result should take
error_prompt_vacio: Write a prompt so we can review it.
error_falta_resultado: Tell us what result you expect: without it we can't know what your prompt is missing.
error_demasiado_largo: Your prompt is {n} characters over the 8,000 maximum.
error_limite_de_uso: The AI service has reached its free usage limit for now.
error_no_disponible: The AI service is not available right now.
error_tiempo_agotado: The AI service took too long to respond.
error_respuesta_invalida: The AI service returned a response we couldn't understand.
reintentar_en: You can try again in {s} seconds.
reintentar: Your text is still here: press the button to try again.
preguntas_titulo: To fine-tune the improvement, answer if you can
preguntas_ayuda: You can leave blank the ones you don't know: we won't make that information up, we'll mark it for you to complete.
completar_aviso: Fill in what is marked [COMPLETAR: …] before using the prompt: it's information you didn't give us and we didn't want to make up.
copiar_ayuda: Copy the text in the “Improved” column and use it in your AI tool.
error_estado_invalido: We couldn't recover the review. Please review your prompt again.
